verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a rich app platform (Tabs, Message extensions, Message streaming, Slash commands, Emoji reactions) that supports building interactive experiences inside chat, and the Agents Toolkit CLI supports scaffolding these apps. However, the evidence never explicitly names Adaptive Cards, task modules/modals, or button-based structured message layouts, so the specific UI primitives in the story are only inferable, not directly documented, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of building such UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Adaptive Cards/task modules/dialogs and buttons, and independent developer confirmation these UI elements work well in practice.
